welcome.title: A morning at Al Noor Residency, with {brand}
welcome.body: One hostel, a few minutes: a new resident checks in, month-end billing goes out on WhatsApp, a complaint gets fixed, the kitchen cooks less, and the owner asks a question in Malayalam. Everything here is live.

kpis.title: Everything the owner checks each morning
kpis.body: Occupancy, billing, collections, profit and complaints update on their own as payments and requests come in. No spreadsheets, no calls to the warden.

attention.title: What needs you today
attention.body: From overdue rent to leave requests waiting for parents, each line opens the right screen.

checkin.title: A new resident walks in
checkin.body: Aiswarya, a software engineer at UL Cyberpark, is moving into Block C. Check-in starts from the floor plan.

details.title: Details in seconds
details.body: Name, phone, job and parent contact. In real use the resident fills this on her phone before arriving.

digilocker.title: Aadhaar KYC through DigiLocker
digilocker.body: No photocopies. She approves on her phone and StayOS fetches the verified Aadhaar record. Only the last four digits are stored.

verified.title: Verified
verified.body: Name, date of birth and address now come straight from DigiLocker. The police verification form is filled in from this.

bed.title: The best bed, suggested
bed.body: Vacant beds in the right block come first, with roommates' colleges and companies, so the warden can place people sensibly.

confirm.title: First invoice, done for you
confirm.body: Pro-rated rent and mess, plus the refundable deposit. A welcome message with the UPI link goes to her WhatsApp, and to her father's.

floor.title: Her bed lights up on the floor plan
floor.body: Occupancy, invoices and the police form update at the same moment. Drag any resident to another bed to move them.

raise.title: Month-end in one click
raise.body: It's the 27th. Instead of a day of WhatsApp messages and a notebook, the owner raises every December invoice at once.

raiseConfirm.title: Mess rebates applied automatically
raiseConfirm.body: Residents who were away three or more days in a row get their rebate on the invoice. Nobody has to work it out.

raised.title: December is billed
raised.body: Every invoice is out with its own UPI link. Collections start the moment people pay.

remind.title: Now, November's late payers
remind.body: Reminders go to everyone overdue on WhatsApp in one go. No awkward phone calls.

remindPreview.title: Personal, not spammy
remindPreview.body: Each resident gets their own amount, days overdue and UPI link, from the hostel's verified WhatsApp Business number.

waReminder.title: It lands on her phone
waReminder.body: This is Anjali's chat. She can pay from the link in seconds, or reply and the StayOS bot answers.

upi.title: She pays. Watch the row.
upi.body: Anjali taps Pay and enters her UPI PIN. The bank confirms and StayOS marks the invoice paid on its own. No screenshots, no manual entry.

receipt.title: Receipt sent automatically
receipt.body: She and her father both get a receipt with the UPI reference. The owner's collection numbers have already moved.

complaintIn.title: A complaint comes in on WhatsApp
complaintIn.body: Arjun in B-108 writes in Manglish with a photo. The StayOS bot understands it, logs an electrical complaint and replies with a 4-hour SLA.

complaintCard.title: On the board, with a live SLA timer
complaintCard.body: No complaint lives only in someone's phone anymore. The warden sees it, with the clock counting down.

complaintStart.title: Assign and start
complaintStart.body: Biju the electrician is assigned and Arjun is told on WhatsApp that help is on the way.

complaintResolve.title: Fixed and closed
complaintResolve.body: One tap marks it resolved, and the SLA result goes into the month's report.

complaintWa.title: The resident stays in the loop
complaintWa.body: Every status change reached Arjun on WhatsApp automatically, ending with a request to rate the fix.

messSkip.title: Anjali skips dinner from her phone
messSkip.body: She'll be at the library late, so she switches dinner off in the resident app. It takes a second.

headcount.title: The kitchen cooks less, right away
headcount.body: Tonight's dinner count drops instantly. The head cook sees the real number before the 4 PM cut-off.

waste.title: Food waste saved, in rupees
waste.body: Every skipped meal that wasn't cooked is money saved. Rebates for long absences are handled automatically.

ask.title: Ask in Malayalam
ask.body: Rasheed types “who still owes fees this month?” in Malayalam and gets the answer from live data, with a button to act on it.

done.title: That's {brand}
done.body: Check-in with KYC, billing, UPI collection, WhatsApp, complaints, mess and an assistant that speaks Malayalam, for owners, wardens, residents and parents. On the web and on iPhone.
